tools.name: agentbay_local_unavailable
tools.description: Diagnostic: local AgentBay memory is OFF in this session because no SQLite driver loaded (better-sqlite3 native binary missing and Node < 22.5 has no built-in node:sqlite). The memory tools are hidden until this is fixed. Call this tool for the exact reason and the fixes: upgrade Node to >= 22.5, rebuild better-sqlite3, or set AGENTBAY_API_KEY for cloud mode.

tools.name: agentbay_signup
tools.description: Start the signup flow. Cloud mode needs no local SQLite, so signing up also fixes the unavailable local memory on this machine.

tools.name: agentbay_capabilities
tools.description: Introspect this AgentBay MCP connection: surface, available tools, and how to restore local memory.
